title: Add sound to your clip

body.text: AI clips often have no fitting audio, so add
background music (e.g. from Suno) and sound effects
during editing. Sound is half of a clip's emotion — don't overlook it.

example: Making an ad clip → music from Suno (bright, upbeat) + a whoosh sound on shot transitions

title: Export to match the platform

body.text: Choose the aspect ratio to match where you'll post:
9:16 for Reels/TikTok, 16:9 for YouTube, 1:1 for a square feed
. Set it from the start so you don't have to crop later and ruin the composition.

example: Making a TikTok clip → set 9:16 from the start, place the subject centered in the vertical frame
